findings.issue: loadMoveTables fetches every move record for the selected game in a single unbounded Promise.all; a TM-heavy Pokémon triggers 100+ parallel requests per first visit
findings.suggestion: Reuse a typed cache and batch with a small concurrency limit, or lazily fetch move details as rows render

findings.issue: `npm run build` runs only `vite build`; Vite never type-checks, so the strict tsconfig is unenforced and type errors ship silently
findings.suggestion: Add `tsc --noEmit` (current TS 7 equivalent) to the build script or a separate `typecheck` script wired into CI

findings.issue: apiFetch<any> and `(record: any)` bypass the typed API layer even though MoveRecord is already defined in api.ts:81
findings.suggestion: Type the call as apiFetch<MoveRecord> and delete the any annotations

findings.issue: Clicking a same-page hash link (e.g. #moves) pushes a history entry and re-renders the whole route, re-fetching from cache and flickering
findings.suggestion: Detect pathname+search equality and just scrollIntoView without pushState/re-render

findings.issue: api.ts is a god module: HTTP transport, presentation formatters (humanize, formatDex, displayNumber) and derived aggregates (getHomeData) all in one file that every page imports
findings.suggestion: Split into api/transport, format helpers, and domain data modules so boundaries are explicit

findings.issue: Global response cache is unbounded (Map keyed by URL); a long browsing session over 1000+ species accumulates indefinitely
findings.suggestion: Spec permits runtime caching, but add a size cap or note the intended lifetime; keep the existing rejection-cleanup behavior

findings.issue: A move with null damage_class renders 'Unknown' instead of the spec's em dash for missing values
findings.suggestion: Use displayNumber-style handling: humanize when present, '—' when null

findings.issue: Inline `onerror` attribute on card sprites is the only inline JS in the app and breaks the no-inline-handlers convention
findings.suggestion: Attach a delegated 'error' capture listener on the list container to hide broken sprites

findings.issue: Hash-scroll logic duplicated between renderRoute (main.ts:65-71) and the pokemon page
findings.suggestion: Keep it in the router only and delete the page-local copy

findings.issue: renderEvolutionNode hand-builds /pokemon/ hrefs instead of using speciesHref from components.ts
findings.suggestion: Import speciesHref to keep URL construction in one place

summary: A well-organized, current-tooling vanilla TS/Vite app that handles the genuinely hard parts — routing races, 404 flows, HTML escaping, cache cleanup — correctly and idiomatically. The main merge blockers are process-level (no type-check in the build) and one unbounded fetch fan-out in the moves section, plus an api.ts god module that will need splitting as the app grows. I'd approve after one round of small, well-scoped changes.
